description:
You have a BookTrackerApp project open in Android Studio at /home/ga/AndroidStudioProjects/BookTrackerApp. The app currently creates its BookRepository manually in MainActivity. Your task is to integrate Hilt dependency injection so that BookRepository is injected automatically.

Perform the following changes:

1. Add the Hilt Gradle plugin to the project-level build.gradle:
   - Add: id 'com.google.dagger.hilt.android' version '2.50' apply false

2. In app/build.gradle, add the kapt and Hilt plugins and dependencies:
   - Apply plugin: id 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.kapt'
   - Apply plugin: id 'com.google.dagger.hilt.android'
   - Add dependency: implementation 'com.google.dagger:hilt-android:2.50'
   - Add dependency: kapt 'com.google.dagger:hilt-compiler:2.50'

3. Create a new file app/src/main/java/com/example/booktracker/BookTrackerApplication.kt:
   - It should be annotated with @HiltAndroidApp and extend Application

4. Update AndroidManifest.xml to register the Application class:
   - Add android:name=".BookTrackerApplication" to the <application> tag

5. Update MainActivity.kt:
   - Add @AndroidEntryPoint annotation to the class
   - Change the bookRepository property to use @Inject lateinit var instead of direct instantiation
   - Remove the = BookRepository() initialization

6. Update BookRepository.kt:
   - Add @Inject constructor() so Hilt knows how to create it
   - Change: class BookRepository @Inject constructor() {

7. After making all changes, sync the project and ensure it builds successfully.

The project should compile with ./gradlew assembleDebug without errors.
